Transfer Function Simulation and Case Studies

Box–Jenkins transfer function models Y_t = \mu + \frac{\omega(B)}{\delta(B)}B^b X_t + N_t: how an output responds dynamically to one or several inputs, step by step from identification to forecasting. Model fungsi transfer Box–Jenkins Y_t = \mu + \frac{\omega(B)}{\delta(B)}B^b X_t + N_t: bagaimana output merespons secara dinamis terhadap satu atau beberapa input, langkah demi langkah dari identifikasi sampai peramalan.

The steps of every analysis Langkah setiap analisis

  1. 1 Stationarity Stasioneritas
    same differencing or adjustment for the output and the inputs differencing atau penyesuaian yang sama untuk output dan input
  2. 2 Input model and prewhitening Model input dan prewhitening
    an ARMA model for the input defines the filter applied to both series model ARMA untuk input menentukan filter bagi kedua deret
  3. 3 Identification of (b, r, s) Identifikasi (b, r, s)
    CCF of the prewhitened series (one input) or free-form weights (several inputs) CCF deret hasil prewhitening (satu input) atau bobot bebas (banyak input)
  4. 4 Noise model Model noise
    ARMA model for the preliminary noise model ARMA untuk noise awal
  5. 5 Joint estimation Estimasi bersama
    all parameters by maximum likelihood with TSA::arimax semua parameter dengan maximum likelihood melalui TSA::arimax
  6. 6 Diagnostic checking Pemeriksaan diagnostik
    white residuals (Ljung–Box), no correlation with the prewhitened inputs (Q₀) residual putih (Ljung–Box), tidak berkorelasi dengan input hasil prewhitening (Q₀)
  7. 7 Explicit equation Persamaan eksplisit
    the model as a difference equation in the original variables model sebagai persamaan beda dalam variabel asli
  8. 8 Forecasting Peramalan
    ex ante and ex post forecasts against a univariate ARIMA, by horizon ramalan ex ante dan ex post dibandingkan ARIMA univariat, per horizon

The transfer function model Model fungsi transfer

An output Y_t responds dynamically to an input X_t through the impulse response weights \nu_k, plus a noise N_t that is independent of the input: Output Y_t merespons input X_t secara dinamis melalui bobot respons impuls \nu_k, ditambah noise N_t yang independen dari input:

Y_t = \mu + \nu(B)\,X_t + N_t = \mu + \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \nu_k X_{t-k} + N_t .

\nu_k is the effect on Y_t of a one-unit change of X that happened k periods earlier. An infinite set of weights is described with a few parameters by the rational form \nu_k adalah efek pada Y_t dari perubahan satu unit X yang terjadi k periode sebelumnya. Himpunan bobot yang tak hingga digambarkan dengan sedikit parameter oleh bentuk rasional

\nu(B) = \frac{\omega(B)}{\delta(B)}\,B^b,\qquad \omega(B) = \omega_0 + \omega_1 B + \cdots + \omega_s B^s,\qquad \delta(B) = 1 - \delta_1 B - \cdots - \delta_r B^r ,

with delay b (the number of periods before the input acts), s unpatterned weights after the first, and a decay governed by the r roots of \delta(B), which must lie outside the unit circle (stability). The noise follows an ARMA model, N_t = \frac{\theta(B)}{\phi(B)}a_t. dengan tunda b (banyaknya periode sebelum input berpengaruh), s bobot tak berpola setelah bobot pertama, dan peluruhan yang diatur oleh r akar \delta(B), yang harus di luar lingkaran satuan (stabil). Noise mengikuti model ARMA, N_t = \frac{\theta(B)}{\phi(B)}a_t.

The steady-state gain g = \sum_k \nu_k = \omega(1)/\delta(1) is the total change of the output after a permanent one-unit change of the input. With several inputs, Y_t = \mu + \sum_j \frac{\omega_j(B)}{\delta_j(B)}X_{j,t-b_j} + N_t, one rational term per input. Gain jangka panjang g = \sum_k \nu_k = \omega(1)/\delta(1) adalah total perubahan output setelah input naik satu unit secara permanen. Dengan beberapa input, Y_t = \mu + \sum_j \frac{\omega_j(B)}{\delta_j(B)}X_{j,t-b_j} + N_t, satu suku rasional per input.

Sign convention: as in TSA::arimax() and in the notebook, the numerator is written with plus signs; Box and Jenkins write \omega(B) = \omega_0 - \omega_1 B - \cdots. The MA polynomial of the noise follows R: \theta(B) = 1 + \theta_1 B + \cdots. Konvensi tanda: seperti di TSA::arimax() dan di notebook, pembilang ditulis dengan tanda plus; Box dan Jenkins menulis \omega(B) = \omega_0 - \omega_1 B - \cdots. Polinomial MA noise mengikuti R: \theta(B) = 1 + \theta_1 B + \cdots.

Typical impulse responses Respons impuls yang khas
The six patterns are the transfer functions of the simulations S1–S5 and an alternating response. Keenam pola adalah fungsi transfer simulasi S1–S5 dan satu respons berselang-seling.
Prewhitening and the cross-correlation function Prewhitening dan fungsi korelasi silang

The sample cross-correlations of two autocorrelated series are strongly correlated with each other, so even independent series show large spurious cross-correlations (see the demonstration). The cure is to filter both series with the model of the input: Korelasi silang sampel dua deret yang berautokorelasi saling berkorelasi kuat, sehingga deret yang independen pun memperlihatkan korelasi silang semu yang besar (lihat demonstrasi). Obatnya adalah memfilter kedua deret dengan model input:

\phi_x(B)\,x_t = \theta_x(B)\,\alpha_t \;\Rightarrow\; \alpha_t = \frac{\phi_x(B)}{\theta_x(B)}\,x_t,\qquad \beta_t = \frac{\phi_x(B)}{\theta_x(B)}\,y_t .

Because \alpha_t is white noise and the same filter is applied to y_t, the model \beta_t = \nu(B)\alpha_t + \varepsilon_t keeps the weights, and the cross-correlations of the prewhitened series are proportional to them: Karena \alpha_t white noise dan filter yang sama diterapkan pada y_t, model \beta_t = \nu(B)\alpha_t + \varepsilon_t tetap mempertahankan bobotnya, dan korelasi silang deret hasil prewhitening sebanding dengan bobot tersebut:

\hat\nu_k = r_{\alpha\beta}(k)\,\frac{s_\beta}{s_\alpha},\qquad r_{\alpha\beta}(k) = \mathrm{cor}(\beta_{t+k},\, \alpha_t),\qquad \text{approx. bounds } \pm 2/\sqrt{n} .

Reading the weights: b is the lag of the first significant weight; after s further unpatterned weights, a cut-off means r = 0, a geometric decay r = 1 and a damped sine wave r = 2. Significant cross-correlations at negative lags indicate feedback from Y to X, which a transfer function does not allow. Membaca bobot: b adalah lag bobot signifikan pertama; setelah s bobot tak berpola berikutnya, bobot yang terpotong berarti r = 0, peluruhan geometrik r = 1, dan gelombang sinus teredam r = 2. Korelasi silang signifikan pada lag negatif menandakan umpan balik dari Y ke X, yang tidak diizinkan dalam fungsi transfer.

Demonstration: spurious cross-correlation Demonstrasi: korelasi silang semu

Two independent AR(1) series with the same coefficient φ. Left: raw CCF. Right: CCF after prewhitening both with the AR(1) model of X. Dua deret AR(1) independen dengan koefisien φ yang sama. Kiri: CCF mentah. Kanan: CCF setelah keduanya diprewhitening dengan model AR(1) dari X.

Preliminary estimates Estimasi awal

Multiplying \nu(B)\,\delta(B) = \omega(B)B^b out and comparing the coefficients of B^j gives, with Box–Jenkins signs, Mengalikan \nu(B)\,\delta(B) = \omega(B)B^b dan membandingkan koefisien B^j memberikan, dengan tanda Box–Jenkins,

\nu_j = \begin{cases} 0, & j < b \\ \delta_1\nu_{j-1} + \cdots + \delta_r\nu_{j-r} + \omega_0, & j = b \\ \delta_1\nu_{j-1} + \cdots + \delta_r\nu_{j-r} - \omega_{j-b}, & j = b+1, \dots, b+s \\ \delta_1\nu_{j-1} + \cdots + \delta_r\nu_{j-r}, & j > b + s .\end{cases}

The last line gives \delta_1, \dots, \delta_r from the weights \hat\nu_{b+s+1}, \dots, \hat\nu_{b+s+r}; the others then give \omega_0, \dots, \omega_s. These rough values start the estimation and give a first estimate of the noise. Baris terakhir memberikan \delta_1, \dots, \delta_r dari bobot \hat\nu_{b+s+1}, \dots, \hat\nu_{b+s+r}; baris lainnya lalu memberikan \omega_0, \dots, \omega_s. Nilai kasar ini mengawali estimasi dan memberi estimasi pertama noise.

Several inputs: the free-form (LTF) approach Banyak input: pendekatan bobot bebas (LTF)

With several, often correlated inputs, prewhitening one input at a time mixes their effects. The linear transfer function (LTF) approach regresses the output on lags 0, \dots, k of all inputs at once, with a proxy AR(1) noise: Dengan beberapa input yang sering berkorelasi, prewhitening satu input demi satu input mencampur efeknya. Pendekatan fungsi transfer linear (LTF) meregresikan output pada lag 0, \dots, k dari semua input sekaligus, dengan noise proksi AR(1):

Y_t = \mu + \beta t + \sum_j \sum_{i=0}^{k} \nu_{j,i}\,X_{j,t-i} + \eta_t,\qquad (1 - \phi_1 B)\,\eta_t = a_t .

The estimated weights with \pm 2 standard errors play the role of the CCF: they show (b, r, s) for every input, and inputs without significant weights are dropped. The proxy coefficient \hat\phi_1 shows whether the errors need differencing; their ACF and PACF identify the noise model. Bobot terestimasi dengan \pm 2 galat baku berperan seperti CCF: bobot tersebut memperlihatkan (b, r, s) setiap input, dan input tanpa bobot signifikan dibuang. Koefisien proksi \hat\phi_1 menunjukkan apakah galat perlu differencing; ACF dan PACF galat mengidentifikasi model noise.

Joint estimation Estimasi bersama

All parameters, \mu, the \omega's and \delta's of every input and the ARMA parameters of the noise, are estimated together by maximum likelihood with TSA::arimax(): for given parameters the transfer function components are subtracted and the exact Gaussian ARMA likelihood of the remaining noise is computed with the Kalman filter. Semua parameter, \mu, \omega dan \delta setiap input, serta parameter ARMA noise, diestimasi bersama dengan maximum likelihood melalui TSA::arimax(): untuk parameter tertentu komponen fungsi transfer dikurangkan, lalu likelihood Gaussian eksak dari noise yang tersisa dihitung dengan filter Kalman.

a_t = \frac{\phi(B)}{\theta(B)}\Big[y_t - \mu - \sum_j \frac{\omega_j(B)}{\delta_j(B)}x_{j,t-b_j}\Big],\qquad \hat{\boldsymbol\vartheta} = \arg\max\, \ell(\boldsymbol\vartheta) .

Standard errors come from the inverse Hessian; z = \hat\vartheta/\mathrm{se} tests each parameter. Alternative orders are compared with the AIC. Galat baku berasal dari invers Hessian; z = \hat\vartheta/\mathrm{se} menguji setiap parameter. Orde alternatif dibandingkan dengan AIC.

Diagnostic checking Pemeriksaan diagnostik

Two checks are needed. The noise model is adequate if the residuals \hat a_t are white noise (Ljung–Box test with p + q degrees of freedom removed). The transfer function is adequate if the residuals are uncorrelated with the prewhitened input: Dibutuhkan dua pemeriksaan. Model noise memadai bila residual \hat a_t white noise (uji Ljung–Box dengan p + q derajat bebas dikurangkan). Fungsi transfer memadai bila residual tidak berkorelasi dengan input hasil prewhitening:

Q_0 = m(m+2)\sum_{k=0}^{K} \frac{r^2_{\alpha\hat a}(k)}{m-k} \;\sim\; \chi^2_{K+1-(r+s+1)} .

A significant Q_0 with a white residual series points to a wrong transfer function (often b or s); an autocorrelated residual series with a small Q_0 points to the noise model. With several inputs, each input is prewhitened with its own ARIMA model for this test. Q_0 yang signifikan dengan residual putih menunjukkan fungsi transfer yang salah (sering b atau s); residual berautokorelasi dengan Q_0 kecil menunjukkan model noise yang salah. Dengan beberapa input, setiap input diprewhitening dengan model ARIMA-nya sendiri untuk uji ini.

The explicit equation and its forecasts Persamaan eksplisit dan ramalannya

Multiplying the model by \delta(B)\phi(B) (and by (1-B)^d when the series were differenced) gives a difference equation in the original variables, Mengalikan model dengan \delta(B)\phi(B) (dan dengan (1-B)^d bila deret di-difference) menghasilkan persamaan beda dalam variabel asli,

A(B)\,Y_t = c + C(B)\,X_{t-b} + D(B)\,a_t,\qquad A = \delta\phi(1-B)^d,\; C = \omega\phi(1-B)^d,\; D = \delta\theta,\; c = \mu\,\delta(1)\phi(1) .

Forecasts follow recursively: observed values where available, forecasts of Y otherwise, and future shocks a_{t+m} = 0. Up to h = b only observed inputs enter; beyond that the inputs themselves must be forecast. Ramalan dihitung secara rekursif: nilai teramati bila tersedia, ramalan Y bila tidak, dan guncangan masa depan a_{t+m} = 0. Sampai h = b hanya input teramati yang masuk; setelah itu input sendiri harus diramal.

Ex ante, ex post and the evaluation Ex ante, ex post, dan evaluasi

Ex ante forecasts use forecasts of the inputs (what a forecaster really has); ex post forecasts use the observed future inputs and show the best the model can do. The gap between the two is the price of input uncertainty. Ramalan ex ante memakai ramalan input (yang benar-benar dimiliki peramal); ramalan ex post memakai input masa depan yang teramati dan menunjukkan kemampuan terbaik model. Selisih keduanya adalah harga ketidakpastian input.

The forecasting method of every input (ARIMA, ETS, Theta, naive or mean; for seasonal inputs ARIMA with Fourier terms, STL + ETS or seasonal naive) is chosen by time-series cross-validation on the training period. The model is re-estimated on the training period and evaluated from every origin of the test period (rolling origin), against auto.arima() for the output alone. Metode peramalan setiap input (ARIMA, ETS, Theta, naive, atau rata-rata; untuk input musiman ARIMA dengan suku Fourier, STL + ETS, atau seasonal naive) dipilih dengan validasi silang deret waktu pada periode latih. Model diestimasi ulang pada periode latih dan dievaluasi dari setiap origin periode uji (rolling origin), dibandingkan dengan auto.arima() untuk output saja.

About the data Tentang data

The denominator has complex roots, so the response overshoots and oscillates while it dies out. The input is already white noise: no prewhitening is needed. Penyebut memiliki akar kompleks, sehingga respons melampaui lalu berosilasi sambil meluruh. Input sudah white noise: tidak perlu prewhitening.

True model Model sebenarnya : Y_t = 30 + \frac{3.0}{1 - 1.2B + 0.5B^2}\,X_{t-1} + (1 + 0.5B)\,a_t,\quad X_t \text{ white noise}

About the data Tentang data

A decaying response to X_1 after one period and a two-period response to X_2, identified together from the free-form weights. Respons meluruh terhadap X_1 setelah satu periode dan respons dua periode terhadap X_2, diidentifikasi bersama dari bobot bebas.

True model Model sebenarnya : Y_t = 100 + \frac{2.5}{1 - 0.6B}\,X_{1,t-1} + (1.5 + 0.8B)\,X_{2,t} + N_t,\quad (1 - 0.5B)N_t = a_t

About the data Tentang data

X_2 is correlated with X_1, so single-input cross-correlations would mix their effects; the free-form model estimates all lags of all inputs at once. X_2 berkorelasi dengan X_1, sehingga korelasi silang satu input akan mencampur efeknya; model bobot bebas mengestimasi semua lag dari semua input sekaligus.

True model Model sebenarnya : Y_t = 50 + 0.02\,t - \frac{1.0}{1 - 0.5B}\,X_{1,t-2} + \frac{0.8}{1 - 0.4B}\,X_{2,t} + 1.2\,X_{3,t-1} + N_t,\quad (1 - 0.5B - 0.25B^2)N_t = a_t

Air and methane were combined in a gas furnace; the output is the percentage of CO_2 in the outlet gas, the input the (coded) methane feed rate. Contoh klasik Box dan Jenkins untuk pemodelan fungsi transfer.

The Southern Oscillation Index (air pressure differences in the Pacific, linked to El Niño) and the number of new fish. Both have an annual cycle, which is removed with the monthly means before modelling. Southern Oscillation Index (selisih tekanan udara di Pasifik, terkait El Niño) dan jumlah ikan baru. Keduanya memiliki siklus tahunan, yang dihilangkan dengan rata-rata bulanan sebelum pemodelan.

About the data Tentang data

Monthly inflow to Lake Shasta in California with precipitation and temperature as inputs. Inflow is modelled on the log scale and precipitation on the square-root scale, after removing the monthly means of all three series. Debit masuk bulanan ke Danau Shasta di California dengan curah hujan dan suhu sebagai input. Debit dimodelkan pada skala log dan curah hujan pada skala akar kuadrat, setelah rata-rata bulanan ketiga deret dihilangkan.

Conclusions Kesimpulan

10 of 13 models pass both diagnostic checks; the transfer function is more accurate than the univariate ARIMA at h = 1 for 11 of 13 series. 10 dari 13 model lolos kedua pemeriksaan diagnostik; fungsi transfer lebih akurat dari ARIMA univariat pada h = 1 untuk 11 dari 13 deret.

What the dashboard shows Apa yang ditunjukkan dashboard
  • Prewhitening matters. The raw cross-correlations of two autocorrelated series are distorted; only after filtering both with the input model do the weights \hat\nu_k show the delay b and the shape of the response. Prewhitening penting. Korelasi silang mentah dua deret yang berautokorelasi terdistorsi; baru setelah keduanya difilter dengan model input, bobot \hat\nu_k memperlihatkan tunda b dan bentuk respons.
  • A few parameters for a long response. A rational transfer function \omega(B)/\delta(B) describes a decaying or oscillating response with two or three parameters, where a free-form distributed lag needs one per lag. Sedikit parameter untuk respons panjang. Fungsi transfer rasional \omega(B)/\delta(B) menggambarkan respons yang meluruh atau berosilasi dengan dua atau tiga parameter, sedangkan distributed lag bebas butuh satu parameter per lag.
  • Several inputs are identified together. With correlated inputs (M2, M3, the LA pollution study) the single-input cross-correlations mix the effects, while the free-form model separates them and reveals a decoy input. Beberapa input diidentifikasi bersama. Dengan input yang berkorelasi (M2, M3, studi polusi LA), korelasi silang satu input mencampur efeknya, sedangkan model bobot bebas memisahkannya dan mengungkap input pengecoh.
  • The value of an input for forecasting depends on the delay. Up to h = b the transfer function uses only observed inputs and gains most over a univariate model; beyond that the inputs must be forecast, and the gap between ex ante and ex post measures the price of that uncertainty. Nilai sebuah input untuk peramalan bergantung pada tunda. Sampai h = b fungsi transfer hanya memakai input teramati dan paling unggul dibanding model univariat; setelah itu input harus diramal, dan selisih ex ante dan ex post mengukur harga ketidakpastian tersebut.
